hook: Krishna water fight heads to Supreme Court *after Nov 18*
hook_b: Krishna water fight heads to Supreme Court *after Nov 18*
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy told officials to present all evidence in the Krishna water dispute with Andhra Pradesh.

beats.what: He reviewed legal strategy with senior counsel C.S. Vaidyanathan and irrigation officials at MCRHRDI.
beats.why: Telangana and Andhra Pradesh dispute their shares of Krishna river water.
beats.care: Krishna water feeds farms in south Telangana and part of Hyderabad's drinking supply.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Deccan Chronicle: Engineers told to speed up Dindi and Achampet lift schemes, fed from Edula.

cards.q: How closely do you follow the Krishna water dispute?

qs: What happens to farm and city supply plans while the case is pending?

facts.t: CM said the existing *2 TMC* Kaleshwaram conveyance is itself facing difficulties.

viz.verdict: Legal and project steps in parallel

steps.e: DPR for Dindi, Achampet tunnels and canals

viz.verdict: Legal and project steps in parallel

learn.t: TMC = thousand million cubic feet of water, about 28.3 billion litres.

watch: The Supreme Court hearing date after November 18.

fact: Telangana preps Supreme Court case on Krishna waters, hearing *after November 18*.
twist: CM says the state cannot use even its existing 2 TMC Kaleshwaram capacity, so no hasty expansion.
